description: AlembicCore public API boundary policy. Exact stable and provisional exports are intentional; wildcard exports are migration-only.

closeout.description: Wave 3A closeout inventory. Manual categories override consumer-derived categories; remaining consumed transitional/wildcard exports are consumer-replace-first, and remaining unconsumed exports are no-consumer-deprecate-candidate.

facadeReadiness.description: Wave 3B readiness map for shared/config/types/candidate deep imports. This does not delete wildcard exports; it tells consumers which exact facade can replace each deep specifier.

./shared/*.reason: The shared exact facade re-exports current shared helpers, schemas, errors, test-mode, concurrency, workspace settings, markdown/diff utilities and tokens.

./infrastructure/config/*.reason: The config exact facade exposes ConfigLoader, namespaces, and direct path/default helpers used by consumers.

./types/*.reason: The types exact facade is type-only and re-exports workflow, snapshot and reactive evolution contracts.

./service/candidate/*.reason: The candidate exact facade re-exports candidate aggregation and similarity services without stabilizing the whole service tree.

./service/knowledge/*.reason: The stable knowledge facade now exposes high-reference knowledge service classes, sync/path/source-ref helpers, and production gateway contracts used by outer repositories.

./service/evolution/*.reason: The stable evolution facade now exposes high-reference evolution services, diff impact helpers, planner contracts, and gateway contracts used by outer repositories.

./repository/evolution/*.reason: The stable repositories facade now exposes evolution repositories and their record/input/status contracts without requiring deep repository paths.

./repository/knowledge/*.reason: The stable repositories facade now exposes knowledge repository implementations and edge/file-store contracts needed by current consumers.

./repository/sourceref/*.reason: The stable repositories facade now exposes recipe source-ref repository contracts and implementation used by rescan workflows.

./repository/sync/*.reason: The stable repositories facade now exposes the sync repository adapter consumed by knowledge sync CLI/runtime code.

./repository/token/*.reason: The stable repositories facade now exposes TokenUsageStore for outer DI modules while keeping construction ownership with the outer runtime.

./infrastructure/signal/*.reason: Signal bus, aggregator, bridge, and trace writer contracts are already re-exported from the stable events facade.

./infrastructure/report/*.reason: ReportStore is still infrastructure support without a stable report facade; consumers can leave file-level deep imports for the exact provisional report entrypoint first.

./core/capability/*.reason: CapabilityProbe is exported by the exact provisional capability facade; it remains runtime capability support rather than a stable root contract.

./core/ast/*.reason: Language-specific AST modules are still test and grammar registration support. Project-level consumers should prefer the stable project-intelligence facade, but lang-* files are not collapsed in this wave.

./domain/evolution/*.reason: EvolutionPolicy is a pure evolution domain policy and is now exported by the stable evolution facade.

./domain/knowledge/*.reason: Knowledge field specs, readiness checks, validators, lifecycle contracts and value objects are exported by the stable knowledge facade.

./infrastructure/database/drizzle/*.reason: Drizzle schema files are database infrastructure internals used by repository tests and local stores; they are not promoted to a stable facade in this wave.

./infrastructure/database/migrations/*.reason: Migration modules are fixture-like schema boundaries for database tests and migrations; consumers must not treat them as stable product API.

./repository/memory/*.reason: Semantic memory repository construction and repository implementation are exposed by the stable memory facade.

./service/bootstrap/*.reason: BootstrapDedup is exported by the exact provisional bootstrap service facade and remains workflow support rather than stable root API.

./service/quality/*.reason: FeedbackCollector and QualityScorer are exported by the exact provisional quality service facade for outer DI replacement.

./service/recipe/*.reason: RecipeCandidateValidator and RecipeParser are exported by the exact provisional recipe service facade for outer DI replacement.

./workflows/capabilities/*.reason: Workflow cleanup policy helpers are exported by the stable host-agent-workflows facade while concrete cleanup I/O remains injected by outer runtimes.

@alembic/core/infrastructure/config/Conf.reason: Default and named ConfigLoader are available from the config facade.

@alembic/core/infrastructure/config/Defa.reason: Frequently used default constants are direct facade exports; namespace consumers can use ConfigDefaults.

@alembic/core/infrastructure/config/Path.reason: Frequently used path helpers are direct facade exports; namespace consumers can use ConfigPaths.

@alembic/core/service/candidate/Candidat.reason: Candidate aggregation is exported by the candidate facade.

@alembic/core/service/candidate/Similari.reason: Candidate similarity is exported by the candidate facade.

@alembic/core/core/AstAnalyzer.reason: Alembic benchmarking scripts only need project AST analysis entrypoints; the stable project-intelligence facade already exposes those symbols without requiring the transitional core/AstAnalyzer path.

@alembic/core/core/ast.reason: AST plugin loading, grammar resources and project graph construction are available from the stable project-intelligence facade; consumers do not need the transitional core/ast index for those symbols.

@alembic/core/core/discovery.reason: Discovery registry and language detection contracts are exposed by the stable project-intelligence facade, so Alembic scripts can leave the transitional core/discovery path.

@alembic/core/core/enhancement.reason: Enhancement registry consumers still include Alembic and AlembicPlugin runtime paths and tests. No stable replacement facade exists in this wave, so the exact provisional core/enhancement entry remains intentionally transitional.

@alembic/core/service/evolution/ContentI.reason: Content impact helpers are already exported by the stable evolution facade; consumers should use the functional facade contract instead of the deep service path.

@alembic/core/shared/WorkspaceSettingsSt.reason: Workspace settings are shared runtime support, not a workspace-project facade contract yet.

@alembic/core/shared/concurrency.reason: Concurrency limiters are exported by the shared facade.

@alembic/core/shared/constants.reason: Shared constants are exported by the shared facade.

@alembic/core/shared/content-hash.reason: Content hash utility is exported by the shared facade.

@alembic/core/shared/developer-identity.reason: Developer identity helper is exported by the shared facade; downstream tests can mock the facade entrypoint.

@alembic/core/shared/diff-parser.reason: Diff parsing helpers are exported by the shared facade.

@alembic/core/shared/errors/BaseError.reason: Error classes are exported through the shared errors index and shared facade.

@alembic/core/shared/errors/index.reason: Error classes are exported through the shared facade.

@alembic/core/shared/folder-names.reason: Folder names are already part of the stable workspace facade.

@alembic/core/shared/isOwnDevRepo.reason: Development repository helpers remain shared support and are exported by the shared facade.

@alembic/core/shared/markdown-utils.reason: Markdown utilities are exported by the shared facade.

@alembic/core/shared/schemas/common.reason: Common schemas are exported by the shared schema index and shared facade.

@alembic/core/shared/schemas/config.reason: Config schemas are exported by the shared schema index and shared facade.

@alembic/core/shared/similarity.reason: Similarity helpers are already stabilized on the search facade.

@alembic/core/shared/test-mode.reason: Test-mode helpers are exported by the shared facade; downstream tests can mock the facade entrypoint.

@alembic/core/shared/token-utils.reason: Token utilities are exported by the shared facade.

@alembic/core/types/reactive-evolution.reason: Reactive evolution contracts are type-only exports from the types facade.

@alembic/core/types/snapshot-views.reason: Snapshot view contracts are type-only exports from the types facade.

@alembic/core/types/workflows.reason: Workflow contracts are type-only exports from the types facade; Wave 3B-Core-2 keeps these as type-only facade exports.
